changes.title: Playtest report retention
items: Written playtest comments stay in your log when older saved moments reach their limit. Saving now tells you when a moment is unavailable or browser storage fails.

changes.title: Pause load latest
items: The pause menu has a "Load latest version" button while a newer build is out
The pause menu's Quality box no longer spills past its panel

changes.title: Dodge echoes
items: Dodging leaves brief silhouettes where the witch departs and arrives.
